models.display_parameters_iid: Independent uniform integer draws and displayed 0.285/0.25/0.30/0.05 parameters; exact rational reference model.
models.native_uniform_grid_iid: Independent uniformly distributed 32-bit native draw inputs and 23-bit Roll grid; primitive bucket counts are exact under this assumption. Actual PRNG state correlations are not modeled.
